title: B10_c1
characteristics_ch1: cell type: peripheral blood mononuclear cells
treatment: mock- and IAV-infected

growth_protocol_ch1: All samples were obtained from BioIVT. Blood was collected utilizing a standard protocol from 90 male African- (AFR) and European-American (EUR) donors between the ages of 21 – 69 using a sodium heparin anticoagulant from the same collection site in the United States. A signed, written consent was obtained from each participant. Briefly, PBMCs were extracted from whole blood using a density gradient, washed with HBSS, reconstituted in CryoStor CS10 to a concentration of 10 million (M) cells/ml, and subsequently cryopreserved.
extract_protocol_ch1: Cells were collected, washed, and prepared for single-cell capture using the 10X workflow. Immediately prior to the capture, cells from samples were combined into two pools (6 samples per pool), so that each pool was balanced for infection status and contained cells from each individual processed that day (either 4 EUR and 2 AFR individuals or 4 AFR and 2 EUR individuals) combined in an equal ratio.
Single-cell GEMs were generated using a Chromium Controller instrument (10x Genomics).

Sequencing libraries were prepared using Chromium Single Cell 3’ Reagent Kits (v2, 10x Genomics), according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Briefly, GEM-RT was performed in a thermal cycler: 53°C for 45 min, 85°C for 5 min. cDNA was cleaned up with DynaBeads MyOne Silane Beads (ThermoFisher Scientific) and amplified with a thermal cycler: 98°C for 3 min, cycled 11 x 98°C for 15 s, 67°C for 20s, 72°C for 1 min, and 72°C 1 min. After a cleanup with SPRIselect Reagent Kit, the libraries were constructed by performing the following steps: fragmentation, end-repair, A-tailing, SPRIselect cleanup, adaptor ligation, SPRIselect cleanup, sample index PCR, and SPRIselect size selection. Libraries were sequenced on NovaSeq S4 and SP flowcells with 100 bp paired-end reads.

characteristics_ch1: cell type: peripheral blood mononuclear cells
treatment: mock- and IAV-infected
treatment_protocol_ch1: Per individual for each condition, 1 million (M) PBMCs were plated at a concentration of 1M/ml and infected with either mock-conditioned media (negative control) or Cal/04/09 IAV at an MOI of 0.5. After 30 minutes of IAV infection, the virus was washed from PBMC cultures, cells were replated, and cells were then incubated for 6hrs at 37C in 5% CO2 and 20% O2.
growth_protocol_ch1: All samples were obtained from BioIVT. Blood was collected utilizing a standard protocol from 90 male African- (AFR) and European-American (EUR) donors between the ages of 21 – 69 using a sodium heparin anticoagulant from the same collection site in the United States. A signed, written consent was obtained from each participant. Briefly, PBMCs were extracted from whole blood using a density gradient, washed with HBSS, reconstituted in CryoStor CS10 to a concentration of 10 million (M) cells/ml, and subsequently cryopreserved.
extract_protocol_ch1: Cells were collected, washed, and prepared for single-cell capture using the 10X workflow. Immediately prior to the capture, cells from samples were combined into two pools (6 samples per pool), so that each pool was balanced for infection status and contained cells from each individual processed that day (either 4 EUR and 2 AFR individuals or 4 AFR and 2 EUR individuals) combined in an equal ratio.
Single-cell GEMs were generated using a Chromium Controller instrument (10x Genomics).

Sequencing libraries were prepared using Chromium Single Cell 3’ Reagent Kits (v2, 10x Genomics), according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Briefly, GEM-RT was performed in a thermal cycler: 53°C for 45 min, 85°C for 5 min. cDNA was cleaned up with DynaBeads MyOne Silane Beads (ThermoFisher Scientific) and amplified with a thermal cycler: 98°C for 3 min, cycled 11 x 98°C for 15 s, 67°C for 20s, 72°C for 1 min, and 72°C 1 min. After a cleanup with SPRIselect Reagent Kit, the libraries were constructed by performing the following steps: fragmentation, end-repair, A-tailing, SPRIselect cleanup, adaptor ligation, SPRIselect cleanup, sample index PCR, and SPRIselect size selection. Libraries were sequenced on NovaSeq S4 and SP flowcells with 100 bp paired-end reads.
data_processing: Sample preprocessing was performed using the count function in cellranger (v3.0.2).
We demultiplexed cells into individuals and respective infection conditions using souporcell (v2.0) (Heaton et al., 2020)
We excluded cells that featured: 1) a “singlet” status called by souporcell, 2) between 200 – 2500 genes detected (nFeature_RNA), and 3) a mitochondrial reads percentage < 10%

We calcualted pseudobulk estimates for each major immune cell cluster (5) by summing the raw UMI counts across all cells assigned to that sample for each gene using the sparse_Sums function in textTinyR (v1.1.3)

We filtered out lowly-expressed genes based on cluster-specific logCPM values (removed genes with a median logCPM < 1.5 in CD4+ T cells, monocytes, and PBMCs, < 2.5 in B cells and CD8+ T cells, and < 4.0 in NK cells)
We used the function voom from the R package limma (Ritchie et al., 2015) to normalize the pseudobulk data
Genome_build: GRCh38.p12 and influenza A virus (A/California/04/09)
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: .mtx files include count values for each multiplexed sample; .tsv files include the description of barcodes (cells) and features (genes)
